events.description: MINUTE ORDER. To ensure the expeditious resolution of the plaintiffs' 14 Motion for Temporary Restraining Order, it is hereby ORDERED that, on or before November 2, 2026, at 10:30 a.m., counsel for the defendants shall enter a notice of appearance in this case. It is further ORDERED that, on November 2, 2026, at 1:30 p.m., the parties shall appear before the Court for a motion hearing, via teleconference, by calling 646-828-7666, entering Meeting ID 161 591 8885 followed by the pound key (#), and then entering the Passcode 984979 followed by the pound key (#). It is further ORDERED that on or before 12:00 p.m. the defendants shall file their opposition to the plaintiffs' motion if they so choose to file such an opposition. It is further ORDERED that the plaintiffs shall forthwith notify the defendants of the contents of this Minute Order. Signed by Judge Reggie B. Walton on November 2, 2026. (lcrbw2)

events.description: 22. MEMORANDUM OPINION AND ORDER. In accordance with the attached Order, it is hereby ORDERED that the plaintiffs' 14 Motion for Temporary Restraining Order, is DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. It is further ORDERED that the defendants shall provide the Court with a status report as to how they confirmed that none of the election monitors participating in the DOJ's Poll Monitoring Program on November 3, 2026 are in fact law enforcement officials and therefore do not have the power to effectuate arrests, on or before November 3, 2026 at 7:00 a.m. Eastern Standard Time.
